segments.title: Salmon Sperm Facial Trend
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple investigate the viral trend of salmon sperm facials, citing Jennifer Aniston and TikTokers, debating peptide science, and interviewing a talking salmon persona named John Salmon.

segments.title: Trailer Roundup: First and Ten, Pac-Man, AI Romance, Mulaney
segments.notes: Trent and parole officer Chris review trailers for the 1984 HBO football series First and Ten, a Pac-Man keytar music video, The Tattooist of Auschwitz, the fully AI-generated show Next Stop Paris on TCLtv, and John Mulaney's live Netflix series Everybody's in LA.

segments.title: Willy Wonka LA Experience Recreation
segments.notes: Case and Trent discuss the House of Illuminati LA recreation of the viral Glasgow Willy Wonka event, debating ironic bullying, the Oompa Loompa's return, and non-refundable $44 tickets for April 28.

segments.title: Extended Pac-Man Freestyle & Wonka Sub Goal
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers a marathon freestyle over multiple Pac-Man trap beats with panther animations, driving a sub goal that results in Case purchasing Wonka tickets live on air.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Salmon Donor, Iguana Walker, Trump Principal, Peta Pumpkin
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews Dudley Berkshire (donating sperm to salmon), an iguana walker who gets his pet crushed, Baron Trump's former principal (a self-described 'hormonger' with a dipping dot spoon brain injury), and Peter Pumpkin/Peta defending dancing panthers.

segments.title: Escaped Dobby Summoning LA Takeover
segments.notes: Clementine analyzes footage of a Dobby escaped from his basement, claiming it is casting a spell to summon a Dobby invasion of Los Angeles from a manicured hill, and asserts viewers are immune due to 'truth strengthening.'

segments.title: Bob Shepherd 1998 Yankees PA Announcer Interview
segments.notes: Case and Pepito watch a 1998 archive interview with longtime Yankees PA announcer Bob Shepherd, discussing his 48-year career, euphonious name pronunciations, and a prank at-bat announcement.

segments.title: Pepito Theme 'Living Pepito Loco' & Raid Outro
segments.notes: Pepito performs a ChatGPT-generated parody of 'La Vida Loca' titled 'Living Pepito Loco,' followed by DJ Newsic's musical outro and a raid to Kassim.

characters.notes: correspondent. Hosted Trent at the Movies, reviewing trailers for First and Ten, a Pac-Man music video, The Tattooist of Auschwitz, the AI show Next Stop Paris, and John Mulaney's Everybody's in LA.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito declared his birthday as 'April Day' (self-declared).
Case has a UCB show on April 21 at 10:30 with John Madison and Tim.
Case purchased two tickets to the Willy Wonka LA experience for April 28.
Clementine's escaped Dobby is allegedly summoning other Dobbies to take over Los Angeles from a manicured hill.
Clementine claims viewers are immune to Dobby magic due to 'truth strengthening.'
Pepito's theme song 'Living Pepito Loco' was generated via ChatGPT parody of 'La Vida Loca.'

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the salmon sperm facial trend with a live salmon interview, reviewed trailers including an AI-generated romance series, and dissected the ironic LA recreation of the Glasgow Willy Wonka disaster. An extended Hype Train freestyle drove a sub goal that compelled Case to purchase Wonka tickets on air, while Trip Bradstein interviewed a salmon sperm donor, an iguana walker, and Baron Trump's former principal. Clementine warned of a Dobby invasion of Los Angeles, Pepito debuted a ChatGPT-generated birthday theme song, and the broadcast closed with a raid to Kassim.
